definitions.explanation: The quantity of particles—most commonly pollen—dispersed into the air over a given area and time. Frequently reported in weather forecasts during {花粉症|かふんしょう} (hay fever) season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
スギ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The amount of cedar pollen dispersal is being forecast.

examples.japanese: ⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧⟦{傾向|けいこう}→傾向：02695_keikou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: When temperatures rise, the amount of pollen dispersal tends to increase as well.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{飛散|ひさん}→飛散：16085_hisan⟧ (scattering, dispersal) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (amount, quantity). In everyday usage almost always refers to pollen, but can apply to any airborne particle (dust, ash, radioactive material).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{飛散量|ひさんりょう}: amount of pollen dispersal
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧／⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧: dispersal is high / low
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧: dispersal forecast
- {飛散量|ひさんりょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ピーク→ピーク：11174_piiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}する→達する：02129_tassuru⟧: dispersal reaches its peak

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{花粉|かふん}→花粉：04372_kafun⟧⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: pollen information — the broader category that includes the count
- ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧: hay fever — the condition affected by {飛散量|ひさんりょう}
